summary: Frontend-only testing of the light landing redesign and the dark signed-in screens (Playwright, 1920 desktop + 390 mobile). All requested checks passed. Landing: every section is light (white/slate-50); the only large dark areas are the coded app mocks and the rounded final CTA panel (slate-900). The nav (white/80 with blur) has logo, 5 links, language switcher, Sign in and Get your number. Hero title is correct; buy CTA goes to /cloudivr/signup; the test CTA scrolls to #try. hero-app-mock and hero-live-ivr-card are visible on desktop, and the card is hidden at 390. Stats read 17 / 60 s / $50 / 8. The coverage grid has 17 countries. The marquee is gone. Free test call: tabs switch; an invalid number shows civr-try-error; +14155550100 opens the light email gate (white card) → preview code → verify → civr-callme-live with timer, keypad and the 'Preview · simulated' tag. Feature cards 0-7 are present, with the IVR/campaign/AI mocks. how-step-1..3 are present. Pricing is $50/$75/$120 with the Pro recommended badge and ring, and choose links go to /signup?plan=<id>. FAQ items expand. Final CTA and footer links work. At 390 there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390) and the hero CTAs stack. Signed-in app (Alice) stays dark (rgb(10,10,10)). All 5 stat icons use the same indigo #818cf8. Your numbers is on the left and Quick actions (3 links) on the right. The active pill uses civr-pill-ok (green #34d399). The recent activity card is below. The sidebar has Numbers/Calling/Account plus the Support group with Suggest a feature (→ /app/settings#suggest). The topbar unread badge is indigo #6366f1 with white text. Buy: step labels 1/2/3 show; a dry-run wallet purchase (Starter $50) worked and redirected to the number detail page; I then deleted the test number. Number detail: tab order and dividers 1/2/3 are correct, and all 14 tabs open their panels. Help centre renders the FAQ articles (it uses faqItems().slice(2) on purpose). No React page errors; the only console errors are expected 401s from the signed-out session check on the landing page.

issues: Bulk IVR campaigns card (feature-card-1, md:col-span-5) is much shorter than the IVR card next to it, leaving a large empty area under the campaign mock. Consider aligning the mock to the bottom or adding content.
The wallet stat in the coded app mock is cut off as '$128…' at mobile width (cosmetic).

At desktop width the 14 tabs plus dividers overflow the max-width container: 'Logs' is faded and 'Billing' is hidden until you scroll the strip sideways. Consider wrapping or tightening the padding so all tabs fit on desktop.
mobile-inbox-unread badge is still red (#ef4444) while the topbar badge is now indigo. Only matters if they should match.

action_items: Optional: make all number-detail tabs fit at 1920px without sideways scrolling (Billing is hidden right now)
Optional: balance the height of the Bulk campaigns feature card
Optional: decide whether the mobile inbox unread badge should be indigo like the topbar badge
critical_code_review_comments: Landing Nav sets a `scrolled` state, but the header class does not use it (it is only used for the sticky CTA). That is fine, but the template literal in className is redundant.
Wordmark accent is hardcoded as #059669 in two places (Nav and Footer); consider a shared constant.
seed_data_creation: Bought one dry-run Starter number on Alice and then deleted it. This took $50 from Alice's wallet ($380 → $330). Created one free-trial email of the form qa.<rand>@example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing is light; the signed-in app is dark. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded'. The coverage-grid children are wrapped in a display:contents <span> added by the visual-edit tooling, so `coverage-grid > div` matches 0. Use `[data-testid=coverage-grid] [data-testid^=coverage-]` instead (17 items). The login submit button is found with get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). Alice's wallet is now $330.
